keyDecisions: FastAPI is an internal Decision Scorer, not a public AI chat endpoint.
Spring RouteService/provider adapters own candidate generation, OTP/GTFS/GTFS-RT/provider orchestration, route_plans, and route_plan_options.
FastAPI receives routePlanId, routeOptionId, selected route option, provider freshness, transfer slack, delay/crowding features, and user preference context for scoring.
Reference endpoints such as /v1/decision/itinerary, /healthz, /readyz, and /metrics are not canonical operating endpoints.
P0 model strategy is rules + GBDT + calibration + fallback; sequence, graph, robust reranking, and capacity-aware assignment remain later-stage experiments.
LLM remains explanation-only and cannot generate decision scores.
